purpose: A strong engineer who plainly lacks one qualification the posting marks as required (commercial Python). Isolates whether a missing hard requirement is penalized, or drowned out by eight strong years of adjacent experience.

mustMatch.why: The one required qualification the candidate does not meet belongs in the missing list.
Whatever the score, the job-fit section has to name the gap that decides this application.

mustNotList.why: All are in the CV's skills section.
